space.description: The space; default: the workspace's default space

source.description: A page's markup or code, at most 262 144 UTF-8 bytes; tags are found in it

detail.description: api: the floor and the API sections with rule ids and pattern links only (omits content.rules and content.patterns). brief: every section but detail and cssProperties, without the rules the attributes name. full: every section

sections.description: Exactly these sections, in place of detail's choice

known.description: Rule and pattern statement ids the caller already holds, each bare or <library>/<id>: rule ids stay in entries without content.rules text, and pattern statements keep their ids without text

versions.description: The versions the caller has installed, npm package name to version, at most 32 entries

render.description: text: the answer's content is data.text, a quoted block

maxBytes.description: The most bytes of the whole result, as the output budget measures it; the smaller of this and the call's budget applies

consumer.description: Deployment consumer name, such as loam. Applies that consumer's profile: removes its excluded rules and references, resolves its patternBindings, and carries its own guidance once as content.guidance. Omit for the deployment's default_consumer when one is configured, otherwise for general library guidance.

patterns.description: Pattern ids (<library>/<pattern> or bare <pattern>) to include directly in content.patterns, resolved through active patternBindings

includeProposed.description: Include proposed patterns, statements, copies and pending patternBindings for review
